'''2007 Utah State Championship Matt Judd LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Judd]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
